title: jasminum humile f. kansuense
intro: Jasminum humile f. kansuense, commonly known as Kansu jasmine, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Oleaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum humile f. kansuense are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Kansu jasmine are believed to be responsible for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
